trailhead.label: Start here: cemetery car park on chemin de Beauvoir, Montmélian, heading for the Calloudes hamlet

cautions: Parts of this walk are exposed; keep your dog close and on a short lead.
Unprotected drop at the Roc de Manettaz belvedere (signed danger).
About 500 m along the chemin de Beauvoir at the start, with a pavement.
No water point is listed on this walk: carry enough for you and your dog.
Follow local signs, lead rules and temporary closures.

emergency.note: Call the European emergency number when urgent help is required. Connectivity is not guaranteed.
